snippet.title: yan魇: Parasomnia | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

Parasomnia is an upcoming narrative focused, puzzle driven horror game by Nimbus Games set in a 1987 fictional Malaysian town. It tells the story of a pair of siblings getting caught up in a supernatural event after being called back to their childhood home.

Wishlist the game and download the demo on steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967220/yan_Parasomnia/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
